title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered insights on meeting quality in the Teams admin center
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and Microsoft's supplied notice, including the rollout windows, administrator roles and telemetry exclusions. The cited documentation supports the role-assignment controls and clearly separated troubleshooting background; searches found no feature-specific licensing or availability switch.
